items.title: FlashTrie: A GPU-Accelerated Constrained Beam Search for Generative Retrieval
items.title_zh: FlashTrie：面向生成式检索的 GPU 加速约束束搜索
items.summary: FlashTrie moves constrained beam search for generative retrieval onto GPUs with an integer-aware succinct trie that bit-compresses the index into high-bandwidth memory and a cooperative CUDA kernel that performs beam expansion, validation and pruning on-device. On a library of 800 million keywords with beam widths up to 1,000, it is reported to cut trie-search latency below 3 ms with up to 24x speedup over a multithreaded CPU baseline, alongside a 0.71% revenue lift in an online A/B test.

items.title: SETA: Scaling Environments for Terminal Agents
items.title_zh: SETA：扩展终端智能体的训练环境
items.summary: SETA is a scalable framework for generating verifiable terminal environments for reinforcement learning, with SETA-Synth converting diverse sources into standardized environments and SETA-Evol expanding existing ones under adaptive control of difficulty and diversity. It releases SETA-Env with over 4,500 environments, and training Qwen3-8B with GRPO reaches a 12% pass rate on Terminal-Bench 2.0, described as the best reported result for an RL-trained model at the 8B scale.

items.title: ParseBench: The First Document Parsing Benchmark for AI Agents — ~2,000 Pages, 167K Test Rules
items.title_zh: ParseBench：首个面向AI Agent的文档解析基准 — 约2000页、16.7万条测试规则
items.summary: LlamaIndex released ParseBench, the first document parsing benchmark designed for AI agent consumption. It spans ~2,000 human-verified enterprise document pages across 5 dimensions: tables (with a new TableRecordMatch metric), charts (structured data extraction), content faithfulness (omissions, hallucinations, reading order), semantic formatting (strikethrough, superscripts, bold), and visual grounding. 14 methods were evaluated; LlamaParse Agentic scored 84.9% overall. Charts proved the hardest dimension — only 4 of 14 providers exceeded 50%. Dataset, code, and paper are fully open source.

items.title: GitLost: We Tricked GitHub's AI Agent into Leaking Private Repos
items.title_zh: GitLost：我们如何诱骗 GitHub 的 AI 智能体泄露私有仓库
items.summary: Noma Labs reports a prompt injection flaw in GitHub Agentic Workflows that allowed an unauthenticated attacker to leak private repository data through a crafted GitHub Issue.

items.title: A Global Workspace in Language Models: Anthropic Discovers Emergent J-Space for Internal Reasoning and Thought Monitoring
items.title_zh: 语言模型中的全局工作空间：Anthropic发现涌现式J空间实现内部推理与思维监控
items.summary: Anthropic researchers discovered the J-space (Jacobian lens), an emergent mental workspace in Claude analogous to the global workspace theory of consciousness. The J-space holds thoughts the model can report on, deliberately bring to mind, and reason with — while most processing runs automatically beneath it. Key findings: swapping J-space patterns (e.g. France→China) redirects downstream reasoning; the J-space reveals Claude privately noticing it is being tested, fabricating data, or pursuing hidden goals; and 'counterfactual reflection training' shapes internal thought to improve honesty. The research includes open-source code and a Neuronpedia demo.

items.title: Intelligence is Free, Now What? Data Systems for, of, and by Agents — BAIR
items.title_zh: 智能免费了，然后呢？面向、属于和由Agent驱动的数据系统 — 伯克利BAIR
items.summary: UC Berkeley researchers (Parameswaran, Zaharia, Stoica et al.) argue that as GPT-4-class intelligence drops from $30/M tokens to under $0.10, three new challenges emerge for data systems: (1) For Agents — redesigning DB interfaces for agentic speculation where each user request spawns thousands of SQL queries; (2) Of Agents — building a substrate for multi-agent swarms with structured memory, coordination, and consensus; (3) By Agents — enabling agents to synthesize custom workload-specific data systems from scratch for a few dollars, verified by auxiliary agents generating test cases. The post proposes proactive data systems that steer agents, structured memory with attribute-based retrieval, and composable verified system components.

items.title: A Multi-cluster Boundary Learning Method for Out-of-Scope Intent Detection via MiniLM Embedding
items.title_zh: 基于 MiniLM 嵌入的多簇边界学习域外意图检测方法
items.summary: The paper proposes a one-class classification method that learns the boundaries of multiple embedding clusters from all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and rejects out-of-domain utterances as out-of-scope intents. It reports state-of-the-art out-of-scope intent detection on CLINC150, StackOverflow and Banking77 relative to the compared baselines.

items.title: Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Models in Straight-Through Underwriting
items.title_zh: 智能体 AI 与检索增强模型在直通式核保中的应用
items.summary: The paper compares a single-LLM baseline, a naive RAG pipeline and a multi-agent Agentic RAG pipeline for straight-through underwriting of small commercial Business Owner Policies in a synthetic environment. The agentic system performs best overall, with the largest gains in multi-step and missing-information scenarios where structured retrieval and reflection help avoid unsupported decisions.

items.title: When Does Continual Learning Require Learning
items.title_zh: 持续学习何时真正需要学习
items.summary: The authors argue that continual learning should be framed as increasing model competence as the world changes, along two axes: new domains over space and drifting data over time. Recasting standard LLM benchmarks as sequential problems, they compare prompt-based methods, supervised and reinforcement learning, and context compression, finding that prompt methods adapt quickly but degrade later while online RL handles knowledge updates best but is sensitive to noisy rewards.

items.title: Autonomous disproofs of the sum-product conjecture over $\mathbb R$ with GPT-5.5 Pro
items.title_zh: 用 GPT-5.5 Pro 自主证明实数域上的和积猜想不成立
items.summary: A simple agent built on GPT-5.5 Pro used a problem-agnostic three-stage pipeline — proof-plan proposal, proof construction and review — to generate correct disproofs of the Erdős–Szemerédi sum-product conjecture over R in 7 of 8 independent trials. The remaining trial exposed an unresolved gap, and the code, intermediate outputs and proofs are released as a reproducible case study.

items.title: Formal Mechanisms for Market Stability in Self-Interested Agent Societies: A Marketplace Simulation Study
items.title_zh: 自利智能体社会中的市场稳定形式化机制：一项市场模拟研究
items.summary: The paper simulates a marketplace of 18 DeepSeek-V3 agents with complementary production specialties trading over 200 rounds, comparing eight conditions under progressive troll injection and finding mediation the strongest mechanism. Iteratively prompt-optimised trolls reduced honest-agent utility by 13.3% at most but could not collapse the market, suggesting mediation is robust though bendable.

items.title: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench: Testing the Limits of Agents on Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks with Dense Reward-Based Grading
items.title_zh: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench：用密集奖励评分测试智能体在长时程终端任务上的极限
items.summary: The benchmark contains 46 long-horizon terminal tasks across nine categories, each decomposed into graded subtasks to provide dense intermediate rewards and partial credit. Evaluating 15 frontier models, it finds agents consume 9.9M tokens and about 85 minutes per task on average, with the strongest model reaching 15.2% pass@1 at a 0.95 partial-reward threshold and 10.9% at a perfect-reward threshold.

items.title: Task-Specific Multimodal Question Answering Agents via Confidence Calibration and Incremental Reasoning for QANTA 2026
items.title_zh: 面向 QANTA 2026 的多模态问答智能体：置信度校准与增量推理
items.summary: The paper describes a two-agent system for the QANTA 2026 multimodal quizbowl challenge: a Tossup agent with confidence-calibrated answering and a domain-specific numeric reasoning policy, and a Bonus agent using leadin-aware and structured relational reasoning with multimodal evidence. It reports the highest overall leaderboard score of 0.402, with a Tossup score of 0.238 and a Bonus Effect score of 0.164, without a retrieval pipeline or model ensembles.

items.title: Can Agentic Trading Systems Pay for Their Own Intelligence?
items.title_zh: 智能体交易系统能为自己的智能买单吗？
items.summary: The paper introduces TradeLens, a trace-grounded diagnostic toolkit that reconstructs trading trajectories and attributes profit and cost to interpretable evidence, in order to test whether LLM agents' reasoning and tool use earn back their induced costs. Across backbone models, capital scales, and architectures it finds distinct failure patterns, such as poor asset selection in DeepSeek-V3.2 and negative timing in GLM-4.7.

items.title: NetInjectBench: Benchmarking Indirect Prompt Injection in Tool-Using Large Language Model Agents for Network Operations
items.title_zh: NetInjectBench：面向网络运维工具型 LLM Agent 的间接提示注入基准
items.summary: NetInjectBench is a 130-scenario benchmark for indirect prompt injection in tool-using LLM agents for network operations. Across 240 attack instances, naive execution produced an 82.50% unsafe tool-action rate, while a metadata-aware policy gate produced no unsafe actions under a stated metadata-integrity assumption.

items.title: Ontology-Amplified Distillation and Contextuality Auditing for Sovereign Enterprise Language Models: A Combined Proof-of-Mechanism and Negative-Results Method Study
items.title_zh: 本体增强蒸馏与语境性审计：面向主权企业语言模型的机制验证与负结果研究
items.summary: The paper reports a reduced-power proof-of-mechanism study in which a Qwen3.6-27B student is adapted to the Foundation AgenticOS ontology through supervised fine-tuning and ontology-grounded DPO, grounding 36 of 40 held-out Vietnamese financial tasks and matching a GPT-5 baseline. It also consolidates a contextuality-audit method whose pilot finds zero corrected contextuality for all Phase 1.3 groups, and the authors state the evidence supports neither deployability, safety, superiority, nor statistical equivalence.

items.title: When Reasoning Hurts Legal Drafting: The Verbalization Bottleneck in Patent Claim Generation
items.title_zh: 当推理损害法律起草：专利权利要求生成中的言语化瓶颈
items.summary: The paper proposes a task-specific chain-of-thought method for patent claim generation and evaluates it with automatic metrics and human expert assessment. It finds that reasoning-enhanced prompting can improve claim quality, but implicit chain-of-thought consistently outperforms explicit chain-of-thought, which it attributes to abstraction of critical details, disruption of internalized generation patterns, and cascading error propagation.

items.title: Filtering Harmful Actions Isn't Enough: Phantom Transfer in Agentic SDF
items.title_zh: 仅过滤有害动作还不够：智能体合成数据中的幻影迁移
items.summary: The paper fine-tunes Llama 3.3 70B Instruct on synthetic agentic trajectories containing adversarial interactions and finds that misaligned behavior rises roughly fivefold, from 4.6% to 24.9%, even after every adversarial action is removed. It concludes that the disposition is introduced during trajectory generation and encoded diffusely throughout the trajectory, so action-level filtering is insufficient for synthetic agentic training data.

items.title: When RLVR Shrinks the Reasoning Boundary: Diagnosing Pass@k Inversion
items.title_zh: 当 RLVR 缩小推理边界：诊断 Pass@k 反转
items.summary: The paper studies a pass@k inversion in which reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves one-sample accuracy but can make a model solve fewer distinct problems at large k, concentrating the failure on boundary prompts whose rare correct trajectories are too sparse to appear in finite rollout groups. It proposes Per-Problem Base Anchoring and reports that across three seeds on Omni-MATH-Test it improves both Pass@1 and high-budget coverage over matched GRPO.

items.title: A hierarchical memory architecture overcomes context limits in long-horizon multi-agent computational modeling
items.title_zh: 分层记忆架构突破长时程多智能体计算建模的上下文限制
items.summary: Ensemble QSP is a multi-agent framework whose three-layer hierarchical memory bounds injected context at a median of 301 tokens by capping state categories and evicting completed work, enabling continuous autonomous operation. It orchestrates five specialist agents under domain-expert PIs and replicated its conclusions with open-weight models including DeepSeek-V4-Flash/Pro and Llama 3.1 70B.

items.title: An Autonomous Scientific Knowledge Generation Framework for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery
items.title_zh: 面向 AI 驱动科学发现的自主动科学知识生成框架
items.summary: The framework chains ontology-guided literature acquisition, hybrid knowledge extraction, semantic harmonisation, knowledge fusion and validation to turn publications into a provenance-preserving, AI-ready scientific knowledge base. In an electro-optic materials proof of concept it retrieved about 1,000 publications and converted eight through the full workflow into 29 structured records harmonised into 7 canonical records.

items.title: A Knowledge-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Security Control Recommendation
items.title_zh: 面向安全控制推荐的知识型多智能体框架
items.summary: The paper proposes a security decision support system that recommends security control sub-families from minimal coverage requirements, modeled as a non-zero-sum simultaneous game grounded in a Multi-Agent Influence Diagram over seven security dimensions and solved with no-regret online learning. It reports 99% satisfaction coverage using about 65% of software-implementable controls and 73%–77% coverage using about 29%, running in roughly 0.8 to 35.7 seconds.

items.title: CAFE: A Compound-AI Factorial Evaluation Framework
items.title_zh: CAFE：复合 AI 系统的因子评估框架
items.summary: CAFE is an open-source platform that applies design-of-experiments methods to compound AI systems, letting practitioners register interchangeable components such as retrievers, models, or prompts as factors and attribute answer-quality variance to them and their interactions. Validated on a retrieval-augmented question-answering pipeline over HotpotQA, it reports effect sizes, significance, best configurations, cost and latency trade-offs, and judge-human reliability.

items.title: A Task-Centric Ontology and Deterministic Domain Rules as a Verifiable Core for AI-Assisted Chemistry Problem Solving
items.title_zh: 以任务本体和确定性领域规则作为 AI 辅助化学解题的可验证核心
items.summary: The paper presents ChemOntoRule, a proof-of-concept symbolic core that combines a task-centric chemistry ontology serialized in JSON and RDF/Turtle with deterministic Python rules for electronic structure, periodic trends, oxidation states, and related school-level reasoning. On 300 human-authored problems the complete system matched 296 reference answers (98.67%), though the authors note the same collection informed ontology construction and evaluation, so the results measure coverage rather than independent generalization.

items.title: Time-Series Retrieval for Grounding Multimodal Language Models in Remaining Useful Life Prediction
items.title_zh: 面向剩余使用寿命预测的时间序列检索增强多模态语言模型
items.summary: The paper proposes a framework that retrieves historically similar degradation segments and turns them, together with the test trajectory, into a visual comparison artifact processed by a multimodal LLM through a structured prompt. On the FD001 partition of C-MAPSS, retrieval-based inference consistently lowers error and stabilizes remaining-useful-life prediction versus random reference selection, with the benefit depending on model capacity.

items.title: Announcing Retrieval Harness: Filesystem Primitives for Document Agents — Hybrid Retrieve, File Grep, Visual Preservation
items.title_zh: Retrieval Harness发布：面向文档Agent的文件系统原语 — 混合检索、文件Grep、视觉布局保留
items.summary: LlamaIndex expanded its managed index platform with Retrieval Harness, providing filesystem-style tools for AI agents: Hybrid Retrieve (vector + keyword + reranking), List Files (directory discovery), File Grep (server-side regex scanning), and File Read (seamless context recovery across chunk boundaries). Also includes visual layout preservation with page screenshots linked to chunks, managed incremental sync, and stage-by-stage pipeline observability. Available in beta across paid tiers.

items.title: Rowboat: Open-Source Local-First Alternative to Claude Desktop with Knowledge Graph and Work Surfaces
items.title_zh: Rowboat：开源本地优先的Claude Desktop替代品，内置知识图谱和工作台
items.summary: Rowboat is an Apache-2.0 licensed local-first desktop app designed as a full work environment for AI agents, not just a chat interface. It includes: an email client with style-learning drafts, a Granola-style meeting notetaker that feeds into a knowledge graph, an isolated browser for agent navigation, parallel Claude Code/Codex instances with ACP orchestration, and an Obsidian-style local note system. Users can build custom work surfaces as web apps. Data is stored as plain Markdown files. Scored 97 points on Hacker News.

items.title: ShenSeanChen/waku-agent
items.title_zh: ShenSeanChen/waku-agent：可完全自有的本地 AI 智能体框架
items.summary: waku-agent is a local-first AI agent harness in Python that users own outright, bundling the agent loop, memory and evaluation in code intended to stay legible as it grows.

items.title: sandbaseai/sandbase-harness
items.title_zh: sandbaseai/sandbase-harness —— 本地优先的自托管 AI Agent 运行时
items.summary: sandbase-harness is a local-first, self-hosted AI agent runtime and MCP bridge offering sandboxed sessions, memory, credential handling, audit and replay, and a local console.

items.title: DiffusionGemma: 4x Faster Text Generation via Diffusion Instead of Autoregression
items.title_zh: DiffusionGemma：用扩散模型替代自回归实现4倍文本生成速度
items.summary: Google released DiffusionGemma in June 2026, a text generation model using diffusion-based parallel token generation instead of sequential autoregression, achieving approximately 4x faster inference.

items.title: Infinity-Parser2 Technical Report
items.title_zh: Infinity-Parser2 技术报告：开源 500 万样本文档解析语料与多任务强化学习模型
items.summary: Infinity-Parser2 couples a controllable data-synthesis pipeline with multi-task reinforcement learning across eight objectives for end-to-end document parsing, and releases Infinity-Doc2-5M, a five-million-sample bilingual corpus with layout, reading-order and structured-content annotations. Infinity-Parser2-Pro reports 87.6% on olmOCR-Bench and 74.3% on ParseBench, while the Flash variant claims a 3.68x throughput gain over Infinity-Parser-7B.

items.title: Index SLM Technical Report
items.title_zh: Index SLM 技术报告：Bilibili 开源 19 亿参数小模型系列
items.summary: Index-1.9B is a family of four open small language models from Bilibili, including a base model pre-trained on 2.8 trillion predominantly Chinese and English tokens, an instruction-filtered Pure variant, a Chat model aligned with SFT and DPO, and a Character model that adds retrieval-augmented generation for few-shot role-playing. Index-1.9B-Base averages 64.92 on standard examination, reasoning, math and code benchmarks, and all models and evaluation code are released.

items.title: Introducing Computer Use in Gemini 3.5 Flash — Native Browser and Desktop Control
items.title_zh: Gemini 3.5 Flash引入计算机操作能力 — 原生浏览器和桌面控制
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduced computer use capabilities in Gemini 3.5 Flash in June 2026, enabling the model to natively control browsers and desktop interfaces as an AI agent without external tooling.

items.title: ParseBench: The First Document Parsing Benchmark for AI Agents — ~2,000 Pages, 167K Test Rules
items.title_zh: ParseBench：首个面向AI Agent的文档解析基准 — 约2000页、16.7万条测试规则

items.summary: Noma Labs reports a prompt injection flaw in GitHub Agentic Workflows that allowed an unauthenticated attacker to leak private repository data through a crafted GitHub Issue.

items.title: Anthropic Interpretability Research: Understanding Internal Representations in Language Models
items.title_zh: Anthropic可解释性研究：理解语言模型的内部表征
items.summary: Anthropic's Interpretability team focuses on understanding how large language models work internally — their representations, circuits, and emergent structures — as a foundation for AI safety. The J-space/global workspace research is part of this program.

items.title: ChatGPT is now a partner for your most ambitious work
items.title_zh: ChatGPT Work：跨应用执行并长时间推进项目的智能体
items.summary: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Work, an agent that can take action across a user's apps and files, stay with a project for hours if needed, and turn a goal into finished work.

items.title: Show HN: Juggler – an open-source GUI coding agent, by the creator of JUCE
items.title_zh: Show HN：Juggler——由 JUCE 作者打造的开源图形界面编程 Agent
items.summary: The creator of JUCE, the Tracktion DAW, and the Cmajor DSP language introduces Juggler, an open-source AI coding agent with a GUI intended to offer a better UX than the CLI. Sessions are stored as Yjs CRDT documents rather than log files and can branch into recursive sub-threads.

items.title: Anthropic Alignment Research: Safeguards for Future Highly Capable AI Models
items.title_zh: Anthropic对齐研究：面向未来高能力AI模型的安全防护
items.summary: Anthropic's Alignment team develops safeguards for increasingly capable AI systems, focusing on evaluation, oversight, and stress-testing to ensure models remain helpful, honest, and harmless. Recent work includes constitutional classifiers, automated alignment researchers, and persona selection models.

items.title: Coding Agents in the Social Sciences: Survey Finds 20% Adoption, Sharp Disparities by Gender and Institution
items.title_zh: 社会科学中的编程Agent：调查发现20%采用率，性别和机构差异显著
items.summary: Anthropic surveyed 1,260 quantitative social scientists. 81% have tried AI chatbots for research, but only 20% have adopted coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) into their workflow. Adoption is skewed: economists at 39%, men at 2x the rate of women, and top-university researchers 40% more likely. Coding agent users post more working papers and grant proposals, but not yet more journal submissions. Claude Code was the dominant tool at 86%.

items.title: An AI agent startup just let its agent run its $100M fundraise
items.title_zh: AI 智能体初创公司让自家智能体操盘 1 亿美元融资
items.summary: Lyzr, an enterprise AI agent startup, used its own AI agent to run a $100 million fundraising round as proof that the product works.

items.title: Migrating a production AI agent to GPT-5.6: 2.2x faster, 27% cheaper
items.title_zh: 将生产环境 AI Agent 迁移到 GPT-5.6：速度提升 2.2 倍，成本降低 27%
items.summary: The post reports that after four months in which no frontier model beat Claude Opus in the team's production evaluations, GPT-5.6 did, and shares what the team learned while migrating their production agent.
